sections.heading: MINOR IN WOMEN AND CHRISTIANITY (Brescia) - ADMISSION DISCONTINUED
lines: Faculty of Arts and Humanities - Faculty of Arts and Humanities

Admission to this module is discontinued, effective September 1, 2025. Students currently enrolled in the module will be permitted to graduate upon fulfillment of the module requirements by August 31, 2028.
Completion of first-year requirements, including 1.0 course in Religious Studies at the 1020 or 1030 level with a mark of at least 60%.

4.0 courses from: GSWS 1020E, Religious Studies 2216F/G, Religious Studies 2222F/G, Religious Studies 2251F/G, Religious Studies 2252F/G, Religious Studies 2253F/G, Religious Studies 2254F/G, Religious Studies 3257F/G, Religious Studies 2290F/G, Religious Studies 2291F/G, the former Philosophy 2067E, the former Religious Studies 2217F/G, the former Religious Studies 2232F/G.
Prior to May 1, 2024, this module was offered by Brescia University College.
